Game Overview

In Monster Rash, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a retro world as a quirky pixel creature in Monster Rash. Leap over deadly obstacles, collect stars to unlock fun costumes, and experience thrilling rocket rides. Master the art of timing in this nostalgic arcade delight, where every jump could be your last and every star is a step closer to a new look.
